post.title: In 2025, Nevada slots kept about 7 cents per dollar
post.ig:
In 2025, Nevada slots kept about 7 cents of every dollar played.

That's the house edge. American roulette has 38 pockets but pays 35 to 1, a 5.26% edge.
Example (hypothetical): $10 a spin for 100 spins = $1,000 wagered, expected loss $52.63.
Nevada requires slots to pay back at least 75% in theory; in 2025 they paid back 92.85% statewide.
US commercial gaming took in a record $78.6 billion in 2025, with slots over $37 billion.

Sources: UNLV Center for Gaming Research (Nevada Gaming Control Board data, 2025); Nevada Regulation 14.040; American Gaming Association, State of the States 2026.
